title: ASI Board Resigns to Allow for the Appointment of an Extraordinary Commissioner
summary:
Three members of the Italian Space Agency’s board of directors have resigned, resulting in the board’s dissolution. This clears the way for the appointment of an extraordinary commissioner to lead the agency following the death of its president, Teodoro Valente, on 16 July.
